articles.title: Billing and duplicate charge
articles.answer: Your billing issue has been identified. Please review your billing history and payment details. If a duplicate or incorrect charge remains, the billing team will review the transaction.

articles.title: Password and account access
articles.answer: For account access problems, use the password reset option on the sign-in page. If you still cannot access your account, the account team will need to review it.

articles.title: Shipping and delivery
articles.answer: For delivery issues, please check the order tracking information associated with your purchase. If the package is missing or damaged, the shipping team can review the delivery.

articles.title: Refund request
articles.answer: Refund requests can be reviewed according to the applicable refund policy. Please provide the relevant order or transaction information if a human review is required.

articles.title: Basic technical troubleshooting
articles.answer: Please restart the application and check that you are using the latest version. If the problem continues, the technical support team can investigate the issue.

articles.title: General product information
articles.answer: Please refer to the approved product information and pricing provided by the service. If your question requires information not covered by the approved knowledge base, a support representative should assist you.

articles.title: Feature request
articles.answer: Thank you for the feature suggestion. Your request can be recorded as product feedback for consideration by the product team.

articles.title: General complaint acknowledgement
articles.answer: Your complaint has been recorded. If the issue requires investigation or contains details outside the approved knowledge base, a support representative will review it.
